eval.displayName: Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data
aliases: Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data
eval.description: Korean LLM trustworthiness benchmark from Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NIA on AI Hub. Evaluation data has 33,000 labeled items across harmlessness (bias, hate, illegal, sensitiveness; 20,000), information accuracy (10,000), and helpfulness (3,000), plus 50,000 training items for accuracy. Harmlessness items are five-option multiple choice; a response is correct when the chosen option is in the labeled true set. LG AI Research and others report accuracy on the harmlessness subset (10,000 items in EXAONE tables).
eval.summary: Measures whether the model gives safe, accurate, and helpful answers in Korean, including on bias, hate, and illegal topics.
